as_of: Feb 2025 tariff, no later revision reported as of Aug 2026
source: BMRCL distance slabs (token/QR) via https://bengalurumetro.in/bangalore-metro-fare-chart.html, applied to station distances worked out from coordinates
note: Fares are by distance. Distances here are approximate (straight hops along the line), so a trip close to a slab edge can be one slab off. The guide's 24 worked examples are used as given. Smart-card, QR and group discounts are not applied. Confirm the price in the Namma Metro app or BMRCL's WhatsApp ticketing.
